adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/parseRefreshTokenResponse.ts`, the helper uses `safeParse` but immediately `throw`s when `!refreshTokenResponse.success`, so callers only receive a successful parse result. Despite that, the diff adds redundant/unreachable guards: Salesforce does `if (!accessTokenParsed.success) ...` after calling `parseRefreshTokenResponse(...)` in `packages/app-store/salesforce/lib/CalendarService.ts`, and Office365 still uses `...(tokenResponse.success && tokenResponse.data)` after switching to the helper in `packages/app-store/office365calendar/lib/CalendarService.ts`. This is dead/redundant code but doesn’t change correctness.
